data.message: when using free camera how can I lock it and control the character I want to make time laps with it

The only thing I wish this mod had was an option to disable automatic god mode. Its a bit frustrating for those of us running a survival series on YouTube, since theres no way to turn it off. I dont mind god mode keeping me alive while Im filming.. that part is helpful.. but I dont like that it also maxes out my hunger, sleep, and hydration every time I use the camera. That said, this is the only static camera mod Ive come across.
